title: World Globe with Gulf of America (12-inch)

comparisons.notes: Same 12-inch Gulf of America world globe listed at $75

writeup: Woot has the 12-inch World Globe with Gulf of America on a wood base for $16.99. The official Gulf of America store lists the same 12-inch globe at $75, so this is about 77% less. Woot shows only 3 in stock with a limit of 3 per customer.
